scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Competing host and guest Book requests activate exactly one topic
T2 starts its own six-minute shared clock at the native Book
Guest cannot forge another topic start while Truth Table is active
Wrong answer charges its authenticated sender once through the existing monster controller
Replay cannot charge another mistake
Late join retains the active topic, shared work and mistake identity
Late join resumes T2's exact deadline and attributed answer receipt
T2 Master handoff preserves current outputs, exact clock and team reservation
Late guest cannot start another topic
Another player completes a shared round while the topic remains reserved
Solved T2 table keeps the team clock and clears outputs for the next expression
Other topics remain blocked between Truth Table rounds
T2 timeout preserves solved and partial work and charges the guest Book activator once
T2 timeout cannot unlock another topic
Guest retries T2 with a fresh six minutes and the same unfinished outputs
Nine native Truth Table rounds release the team reservation only at topic completion
Multiplayer T2 completion freezes the remaining team time
Completing the previous topic allows T1 and starts its existing six-minute timer
Guest can cooperate on the reserved topic while the host stays free
Answer receipt and topic reservation survive the next Book gate
Another topic is blocked between T1 challenges
Next Book activation preserves the shared deadline
Cancellation adds no mistake and does not release the reserved topic
Guest snapshot cannot release the reservation by forging completion
Live master handoff retains the active topic, solved work and exact deadline
Master handoff cannot unlock another topic
Timeout preserves the reservation and solved progress and charges its activator once
Timeout cannot be used to switch topics
Guest can retry the same unfinished topic with a fresh six-minute attempt
Pending channel timeout charges the guest activator once and keeps T1 reserved
All five native T1 challenges release the reservation and stop its timer
Guest can start a new topic only after the previous topic is complete
Another player cannot take a non-replenishing connector already carried by a teammate
The initiating player can leave without releasing the topic reservation; their carried connector returns
Original mistake identity survives disconnect
Remaining teammate can continue the reserved topic after its starter leaves
Capture blocks only the captured player
Captured player's command cannot edit or release the reserved topic
Cleanup preserves native player controls
